headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Dealing with a Leaky Pipe
articleBody: When you spot a leaky pipe, it’s natural to want to fix it fast, but making the wrong moves can make things worse. A common mistake is using only temporary fixes like tape or epoxy for a persistent leak. These might stop the drip for a short while, but they rarely address the underlying cause and often fail, leading to more significant water damage. Another error is assuming a small drip isn't a big deal; even a slow leak can waste gallons of water daily and cause mold, wood rot, or structural issues over time. Don't ignore the source of the leak, whether it's corrosion, high water pressure, or a damaged seal; patching it without understanding why it started is asking for trouble. Also, trying to DIY a complex pipe repair without the proper tools or knowledge can easily lead to a bigger break or an incorrectly sealed joint. It's best to call in a professional who can correctly diagnose and repair the issue permanently.
